referenceOrbit: 2027 Ford U.S. F-150 visualizer, Raptor selection, Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat (PRR), 17-inch wheel selection 64B. Its render shows the R hood, grille R emblem and R bedside graphic. The published model is a Rapid Red 2024 Raptor R with a closed tonneau. The configurator bed is uncovered. The model follows the Ford orbit for the position and rake of the passenger-side front fender radio mast. Ford’s 2024 Raptor R launch photographs also show the mast. The Shelter Green auction truck is pictured without it.

supplementaryReferences.establishes: Supercharger top, front throttle, banks and front drive. The catalog describes a 2024 Raptor R engine in a crate-engine application; its control-pack output is different from the production truck rating.
Front dress depth and supercharger pulley relationship. The catalog photograph shows an uninstalled assembly.

supplementaryReferences.source_type: Ford service bulletin 23B20, Technical Instructions, Figure 3
supplementaryReferences.establishes: Relative position of the 10R80 bellhousing joint, fastener and starter on the preceding 2023 Raptor R 5.2L. Scope covers this connection only.
Ford lists radio antenna mast MCPZ-18813-A for the 2024 F-150. The Ford studio orbit establishes its location and rake for the model.

supplementaryReferences.credit: Ford Motor Company via Car and Driver
supplementaryReferences.establishes: The upright AM/FM whip is present on the passenger-side front fender of a 2024 Raptor R and extends above its roofline.

coverage.exterior: Complete 36-stop orbit of the closely related Ford configurator truck. No same-year D4 factory orbit recovered. Ford’s current visualizer links identify these frames as the 2027 Raptor selection.
coverage.cabin_engine_underbody: Six interior, two installed engine and one underbody 2024 Raptor R photographs from a Shelter Green truck with moonroof. Locally retained previews are 1280 × 853. Original links point to the source images.
coverage.transmission: Ford’s 2024 technical specifications establish 10-speed automatic ratios and the transfer case. The service bulletin photographs one engine/gearbox attachment. No matched photo of the open 2024 Raptor R transmission gearsets was located. Gearset shapes, hydraulic components and hidden routing are illustrative.
coverage.crossChecks: Two 2024 Raptor R Shelter Green exterior photographs in the authoring workspace provide independent front and rear three-quarter checks.
coverage.downloads: The published Ford orbit retains the original unshifted 2160 × 926 image rectangle. Five previously published 960 × 640 zooms preserve their existing crop framing and corresponding cameras.
